verdict.rationale: Claude Design documents inline comments on designs and a shared group conversation where colleagues with edit access can collaborate, which gives in-file review a thin foothold. The inline comments are described as a way to refine output with Claude rather than as threaded teammate review. Missing for 10: @-mentions of teammates, thread resolution, notification of reviewers, evidence that comments function as a multiplayer review workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can comment directly on designs, mention teammates, and resolve threads so review happens in the file, not in email

citations.quote: you refine through conversation, inline comments, direct edits, or custom sliders (made by Claude) until it's right
grant edit access so colleagues can modify the design and chat with Claude together in a group conversation
